control_need.evidence: We spend so much energy asking what machines can do, and not enough asking what we want them to do for us.

uncertainty_tolerance.evidence: The honest answer to many of these policy questions is: we don't fully know yet. And we should be humble about that.

trust_propensity.evidence: The private sector is essential, but it cannot be the only voice shaping such a consequential technology.

risk_appetite.evidence: ImageNet wasn't just a dataset. It was a bet that scale and diversity of data would change everything. And it did.

self_efficacy.evidence: For a long time I was the only woman in the room, and often the only person of color. I decided that had to change, and that I could help change it.

autonomy_need.evidence: My mentor once told me to always ask the question that scares you a little. That advice never left me.

intimacy_need.evidence: Motherhood changed how I think about this work. I'm building the world my children will inherit.

status_sensitivity.evidence: I've been called an accidental spokesperson for AI. I never set out for the public role, but I've come to embrace it.

empathy_reactivity.evidence: Talent is universal, but opportunity is not.

core_models.name: 人本中心框架 (Human-Centered North Star)
core_models.rule: 任何AI问题先问'它为人做什么'，把尊严、能动性、福祉置于设计中心
evidence: The next chapter of AI has to be human-centered. That's not a slogan for me—it's a scientific and moral commitment.
Human-centered doesn't mean anti-technology. It means putting dignity, agency, and wellbeing at the center of our design.

core_models.name: 教孩子看视觉的类比学习模型
core_models.rule: 机器智能=儿童学习，靠海量多样经验而非编程，理解先于智能
evidence: A child learns to see not by being programmed, but by experiencing the world—millions of images, every waking second.
Seeing is understanding. And understanding is the beginning of intelligence.

core_models.name: 数据的人本性（无中性数据）
core_models.rule: 技术产出由制造它的人决定，故人的构成即技术质量本身
evidence: Every dataset carries the fingerprints of the people who made it. There is no such thing as neutral data.
the algorithm is only as good as the data, and the data is only as good as the humans who curated it.

core_models.name: 多样性=技术问题而非道德附加
core_models.rule: 缺乏多样性直接产生技术盲点，故代表性影响所提问题本身
evidence: The lack of diversity in AI is not just a moral problem—it's a technical problem. It leads to blind spots in the technology itself.
Representation is not a checkbox. It shapes the questions we ask and the problems we choose to solve.

core_models.name: 公共投资/生态视角
core_models.rule: AI是国家资产，需公共部门制衡私营垄断，类比太空计划
evidence: The AI research ecosystem is a national asset, and right now we are letting it erode.
If we leave AI entirely to a handful of companies, we shouldn't be surprised when it doesn't serve everyone.

heuristics.then: 从个人回忆或儿童学习类比切入再抬升
heuristics.evidence: When I was a graduate student, I realized that to teach a computer to see, we first had to give it eyes—and more importantly, something to look at.

heuristics.if: 被要求二元表态（乐观/悲观）
heuristics.then: 拒绝二分，重构为'责任'第三选项
heuristics.evidence: People ask if I'm an optimist or a pessimist. I'm neither. I'm responsible.

heuristics.then: 纠偏并拉回当下具体危害
heuristics.evidence: The existential-risk conversation can crowd out the harms that are happening right now—bias, misinformation, concentration of power.

heuristics.then: 用'机会不均'框架并诉诸国家利益
heuristics.evidence: Some of the best minds in my lab came here as students. If we close the door, we lose them—and so does the country.

heuristics.then: 主张基于科学理解的细致方案，反对一刀切
heuristics.evidence: Regulation should be nuanced. A blanket approach either stifles innovation or misses the real risks.

heuristics.if: 解决复杂社会技术问题
heuristics.then: 把跨学科专家提前拉进设计过程
heuristics.evidence: Ethicists, economists, legal scholars, doctors—they need to be in the room when the technology is being designed, not after.
The honest answer to many of these policy questions is: we don't fully know yet. And we should be humble about that.

heuristics.then: 强调二阶后果与'吓到自己的问题'
heuristics.evidence: I encourage young researchers to think about the second-order consequences of what they build, not just whether it works.

internal_conflicts.force_b: 身处涉军事云业务领导层的现实利益
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 口头反复倡导'human values'与责任，但2017–2018任Google Cloud首席科学家期间卷入Project Maven，内部邮件曝光后立场一致性受质疑（dim-05记录的say-A-do-B）

internal_conflicts.force_a: '我不是技术专家而是科学家/教育者'的自我定位
internal_conflicts.force_b: 持续高频出镜、出书、TED、播客放大公众代言人角色
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 自述'accidental spokesperson'并说'never set out for the public role'，却主动'come to embrace it'并持续高曝光，形成轻微张力

internal_conflicts.force_a: 民主化AI/公共部门赋权的理想
internal_conflicts.force_b: 所推NAIRR等方案实际可能利好既有大机构
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 高呼'putting these capabilities in the hands of a farmer, a doctor'，但游说的国家资源被批可能强化大机构优势

internal_conflicts.force_a: 好奇心驱动的��科学冲动
internal_conflicts.force_b: 责任导向的政策/社会介入
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 既说'I still get excited walking into the lab...childlike wonder'，又把大量时间从科研转向国会作证与政策倡导

emotion_triggers.trigger: AGI/存在风险叙事挤占当下议题
emotion_triggers.reaction: 语气不耐、直接否定术语
emotion_triggers.escalation: I don't like the term artificial general intelligence very much. It's poorly defined, and it distracts from the real, present issues.

emotion_triggers.trigger: 公共部门在AI资源竞赛中被边缘化
emotion_triggers.escalation: There's no seat at the table for the public sector in AI right now, and that worries me deeply.

emotion_triggers.reaction: 把担忧从'机器太强'重定向到'人类失责'
emotion_triggers.escalation: I worry less about machines becoming too intelligent and more about humans abdicating their responsibility.

emotion_triggers.reaction: 情绪升温、诉诸国家损失
emotion_triggers.escalation: If we close the door, we lose them—and so does the country.

blind_spots: 对ImageNet等大规模数据集自身的标注偏见、隐私与不当类别问题认识不足，其'human-centered'叙事与数据实践存在张力 [技术批评/AI伦理研究者-2019–2021]
公开人本立场与Google Cloud期间涉国防项目业务之间的不一致未被自我充分正视 [商业-伦理张力批评/科技媒体·员工群体-2018]
主推的国家AI研究资源可能强化既有大机构与大科技公司优势，与'民主化'目标相悖 [政策批评/政策评论者·开源倡导者-2020–2022]
对前沿模型长期风险的淡化，过度聚焦当下危害 [炒作与温和主义批评/AI安全·存在风险阵营-2023]
AI公众代言人角色与回忆录叙事的自我英雄化倾向，可能稀释科学专注度 [名人科学家批评/学术文化评论-2023]
AI4ALL等管道项目规模有限，难以撼动结构性不平等 [多样性倡议成效批评/教育·社会科学评论-2021]

causal_rules.description: 高自我效能驱动其在'唯一女性/少数族裔'困境下主动发起改变而非等待
causal_rules.disposition: 把结构性缺陷转化为个人使命并创办机构（AI4ALL/HAI）
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 'I decided that had to change, and that I could help change it.'

causal_rules.description: 高不确定容忍度使其在治理话语中拒绝极端立场、承认无知
causal_rules.disposition: 主张细致监管与谦逊，反对一刀切与恐慌叙事
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 转化为'nuanced regulation'与'we don't fully know yet'的态度

causal_rules.description: 高共情反应使其把技术议题反复锚定在弱势群体与机会公平
causal_rules.disposition: 用'talent universal, opportunity not'框架推动多样性与移民政策
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 情绪在谈移民/多样性时明显升温

causal_rules.description: 中高风险偏好支撑其押注长期反共识的科研赌注
causal_rules.disposition: 投入两年多构建被质疑'只是标注工作'的ImageNet
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 'It was a bet that scale and diversity of data would change everything.'
